mainEntity.name: When should a real estate agent consider implementing AEO strategies?

acceptedAnswer.text: Real estate agents should consider AEO strategies as soon as they recognize the increasing use of voice search and AI-powered answers by potential clients. This is especially true if you want to be the first point of contact for users asking local property questions or seeking advice on buying/selling. Implementing AEO early helps establish your authority and capture market share in a competitive digital landscape, ensuring your expertise is easily found when needed most.
acceptedAnswer.description: Agents should implement AEO when potential clients increasingly use voice search and AI answers, aiming to be the first contact for local property inquiries and establishing early market authority.
